steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Touch power cord plug to discharge static before PCB work.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Execute service after unplugging the power supply unit.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: Smart Install entered. Continue with component checks below.

steps.title: Smart Install motor/heater check
steps.body: Enter Smart Install (Adjust Time Up + Temp 7 s → SC). Press Start — note OK vs HC.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Enter Smart Install (Adjust Time Up + Temp 7 s → SC). Press Start — note OK vs HC.

steps.title: Compressor terminal wiring
steps.body: On heat-pump models, inspect compressor harness terminals for loose pins or desorption. Reseat and tighten per §1-1 safety note.
steps.sourceExcerpt: On heat-pump models, inspect compressor harness terminals for loose pins or desorption. Reseat and tighten per §1-1 safety note.

steps.title: Post-service Time Dry 20 min
steps.body: Run Time Dry 20 minutes after repair. Verify HE does not return and HC clears.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Run Time Dry 20 minutes after repair. Verify HE does not return and HC clears.

steps.title: Heat-pump cycle stable?
steps.body: Drum heats and tumbles through 20 min without HE/HC?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Drum heats and tumbles through 20 min without HE/HC?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace compressor module or main PCB per Samsung heat-pump service guide.

steps.title: Escalate heat-pump repair
steps.oemOutcome: Compressor or sealed-system fault — follow Samsung heat-pump service procedure.

steps.title: Heat-pump path OK
steps.oemOutcome: Smart Install and post-service run passed without HE/HC.
